title: DineSense AI
short: A local restaurant-review analyzer that separates trained sentiment classification from transparent rule-based aspect tagging.
features: TF-IDF sentiment classification with Logistic Regression and Naive Bayes evaluation
Rule-based Food, Service, Price and Ambience matching
Review analytics and suggestions in a Flask interface
Saved educational model, demo reviews, project report and presentation
role: AI semester project, group work with Muhammad Salman and Shaheryar Khan.

media.caption: Source-based project preview — not a screenshot of a running app

limitations: The sample reviews are hand-written. Accuracy is not a real-world validation. Aspect tagging and suggestions are rules, not trained aspect-specific ML.
run: Create a Python environment, pip install -r requirements.txt, python -m src.train, python app.py; open localhost:5000.
